name: Kick AI Chat Assistant
description: Configurable AI chat assistant for Kick.com

permissions_justifications.activeTab: This permission is required to access the currently active browser tab in order to read and respond to chat messages on Kick.com.
permissions_justifications.storage: This permission is required to save the user's AI chat settings locally in the browser.
permissions_justifications.tabs: This permission is required to detect and manage browser tabs where Kick.com is open.

host_permissions_justifications.https://kick.com/*: This permission is required to access Kick.com pages in order to integrate the AI chat assistant directly into the site's chat interface.
host_permissions_justifications.https://generativelanguage.googleapis.co: This permission is required to communicate with Google's Gemini AI API for generating chat responses.
host_permissions_justifications.https://api.openai.com/*: This permission is required to communicate with OpenAI's API for generating chat responses.
host_permissions_justifications.https://api.elevenlabs.io/*: This permission is required to communicate with ElevenLabs API for text-to-speech functionality.

externally_connectable_justification: External code is used to load UI libraries for rendering chat components.
